title: Grilled Chicken Satay
description: A classic Thai dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection. Serve with peanut sauce for a delicious and authentic experience.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil. Blend until smooth.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix until they are evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, heat the peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the grilled chicken satay with peanut sauce for dipping.
Garnish with toasted peanuts or sesame seeds, if desired.
